question: In a certain code language, ‘PARTIAL’ is written as ‘MZJSSZQ’ and 'RADICAL' is written as 'MZDHEZS'. How will ‘RESPOND’ be written as in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

‘PARTIAL’ is written as ‘MZJSSZQ’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c62203bfabb0ea3328c42f38fcd2d5cb07214efeb7c4fc73ad670b2679ce8282.png] 

And,

'RADICAL' is written as 'MZDHEZS'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4d948768097b7ad4cef772ac4814bb0f82166462f3a37aaf4c9e7aa2de0e631d.png] 

Similarly,

‘RESPOND’ will be written as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e84991521661e9e9e8fa0d001e0e671c0ea32c39fa1b5b159018c17ad1e640cf.png] 

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
